'''HoloNet Entertainment''' was one of the largest entertainment companies in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They ran constant tours throughout the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] to entertain the troops during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
